name: lauras-trip-demo
description: Local HAPI Capability Graph and Arazzo demonstration for Laura's trip

scripts.serve: HAPI_HOME=$PWD hapi serve lauras-trip --specs ./contracts/trip-federated.openapi.yaml --mcp --capability-graph --capability-planning --capability-classifier deterministic --runtime-authority decision --dev --port 3100
scripts.serve:jev: HAPI_HOME=$PWD hapi serve lauras-trip --specs ./contracts/trip-federated.openapi.yaml --mcp --capability-graph --capability-planning --capability-classifier typesafe --runtime-authority decision --dev --port 3100
scripts.serve:jev:trace: HAPI_HOME=$PWD hapi serve lauras-trip --specs ./contracts/trip-federated.openapi.yaml --mcp --capability-graph --capability-planning --capability-classifier typesafe --runtime-authority decision --capability-trace --dev --port 3100
